title: "Karumi vs Floe: AI demo agents compared"
summary: "Karumi vs Floe in 2026: both AI demo agents run your real product live. Compare voice, calls, CRM, security, setup and pricing, checked November 2026."
body_markdown:
Karumi and Floe are both AI demo agents that open your real product and show it to a buyer live, by voice, with no person on the call. Choose Floe if you want a website agent that answers from your docs and a demo set up with its team in about 48 hours; choose Karumi if you also need the agent to join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls, work on every surface you sell through, and pass a security review with SOC 2 Type II today.


Karumi is an AI demo agent: an autonomous agent that shows a buyer your real product live, by voice or chat, and answers questions as it goes. Floe calls itself "an AI demo agent for B2B SaaS" ([floe.so](https://floe.so/) , checked November 2026). So this is two tools in the same category, with different strengths, compared using only what each company publishes.


## What is the difference between Karumi and Floe?


Both run the real product, talk by voice and send the conversation to your CRM. They differ in where the agent shows up, how it keeps up with your product, and security.


Karumi Floe


What the buyer sees Your real product, live, not a recording, replica or tour Your real product in a real browser with a demo account (\[docs\](https://floe.so/docs/demo-agent/overview))


How it talks Voice and chat; the buyer can speak, type or interrupt Voice-led demo; the website agent takes text or voice; optional video avatar


Where it runs Demo link, website widget, chat bar, inline start screen, Slack, and Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls Website agent on your site, demo links, and a video call on Floe's own demo page


Keeping up with your product Maps the whole product and stays in sync as you ship Demo guides updated nightly or weekly; docs re-read on refresh (\[source\](https://floe.so/ai-demo-agent-questions/product-changes))


Languages The buyer's language, set per demo link 21 languages, switched mid-conversation


Qualification Qualification and lead scoring in the conversation Up to eight of your qualification questions, ICP score


CRM and alerts HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio; transcripts, summaries, qualification data and custom fields HubSpot, Salesforce, Leadrat; Slack, Microsoft Teams and email recaps (\[integrations\](https://floe.so/integrations))


Booking Ends on the right rep's calendar and books the meeting Your Calendly or Cal.com page inside the conversation


AI tools (MCP) Yes, from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other clients Yes, from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor


Security SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR SOC 2 Type II in progress, GDPR and CCPA, ISO 27001 planned (\[security\](https://floe.so/security))


Setup First-pass agent for free, refined in hours, not weeks About 48 hours with the Floe team after a code snippet and a demo account


Published pricing Growth and Enterprise plans on \[/pricing\](/pricing), scoped on a call Not published; based on demo volume, no setup fee


All Floe facts in this table come from floe.so, checked November 2026. All Karumi facts come from karumi.ai.


## What is Floe?


Floe is an AI demo agent for B2B SaaS that sits on your website. In its own words, it "answers a visitor's questions by voice or text from your own docs, and opens your real product to show them the answer, live" ([floe.so](https://floe.so/) , checked November 2026). When the conversation ends, the sales team gets what the buyer wanted, saw and asked.


Floe has four agents: website, demo, onboarding and support. Per[Floe's docs](https://floe.so/docs/demo-agent/overview) , the prospect clicks a demo link, the agent opens your product in a real browser, a video call starts with the product on screen share, and a voice conversation begins. It can also show slides or clips, for example of a mobile app.


What Floe does well:


- **Website first.** The website agent starts as a grounded chat on your pricing, landing or comparison pages and hands off to a live demo in the same session.
- **Clear guardrails.** The demo agent is blocked from clicking Save, Submit, Delete, Download and Export in your product.
- **Honest about gaps.** When it does not know an answer, Floe says so and offers to connect the visitor with your team.


Setup, per Floe: a code snippet on your site, a demo login made for Floe, then about 48 hours with the Floe team.


## What is Karumi?


Karumi is an AI demo agent that runs your real product live, end to end, for whoever is asking. It is not a recorded video, a replica or a series of screenshots. The agent understands the product, decides what to show for each buyer, and answers questions as it goes. You can read[how Karumi works](https://karumi.ai/blog/how-does-karumi-work) for the full picture.


What Karumi does well:


- **Every surface.** One agent runs from a demo link, a website widget, a chat bar, an inline start screen or Slack. It also[joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) , so it can work beside your rep on a live sales call.
- **Product knowledge.** Karumi maps your whole product and stays in sync as you ship, so the demo matches what you actually released. See[how Karumi learns your product](https://karumi.ai/blog/how-does-karumi-learn-my-product) .
- **Live demos in outbound.** A live demo link goes into a cold email or sequence, pre-filled for the contact.
- **The buyer's language.** A demo link sets the demo language. See[which languages Karumi supports](https://karumi.ai/blog/which-languages-does-karumi-support) .


## How does each agent run the demo?


Both run the live product, so neither shows stale screens after a release. The difference is in the flow.


**Floe** leads with a website conversation. A visitor asks a question on your pricing page, Floe answers from your docs, and when the visitor wants to see it, the same session opens the product. Floe's demo guides are kept current by a scheduled update, nightly or weekly. Docs changes are read when you run your sources again or turn on automatic refresh.


**Karumi** leads with the live product. The visitor clicks a link, and in about two seconds the agent is sharing its screen. The buyer can speak, type or interrupt, and the agent picks the path that fits the question. Your team is notified and gets the recording. Read[whether a Karumi demo is live or a recording](https://karumi.ai/blog/is-karumi-demo-live-or-recording) .


In our experience, buyers ask about pricing, integrations and security early. Karumi can also carry the same agent into a scheduled call with your rep, which helps when a deal has several stakeholders.


## Which has better integrations?


Both cover the core: HubSpot, Salesforce, booking, and an MCP connection so you can work with the agent from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor.


Floe's[integrations page](https://floe.so/integrations) (checked November 2026) adds Slack and Microsoft Teams recaps, Calendly and Cal.com, Factors, Periskope for WhatsApp hand-off, and Leadrat. A strong point: a delivery log shows each CRM write and why one failed.


Karumi's[integrations](https://karumi.ai/integrations) add Attio, with transcripts, summaries, qualification data and custom fields in the CRM record. See[what Karumi sends to HubSpot](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-does-karumi-send-to-hubspot) . Every session is recorded with analytics, readable by API.


Pick by your stack: Teams channels or Factors point to Floe; Attio or custom CRM fields point to Karumi.


## How do Karumi and Floe compare on security?


This is the clearest difference for enterprise buyers.


- **Karumi:** SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR, with RBAC, encryption, and on-premise deployment and dedicated server capacity on the Enterprise plan. See[security](https://karumi.ai/enterprise) .
- **Floe:** per its[security page](https://floe.so/security) (checked November 2026), SOC 2 Type II is in progress, GDPR and CCPA are in place, ISO 27001 is planned, and a BAA is available on request. Data is stored in the United States (Google Cloud us-central1). Floe offers SSO, audit logs and IP allowlisting on Enterprise.


Floe is open that it does "not claim certifications we have not received," which is fair. But if procurement needs SOC 2 Type II before signing, Karumi has it today.


## How much do Karumi and Floe cost?


Neither publishes a list price as of November 2026.


- **Karumi** has two plans on[/pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) : Growth (custom agents, languages and sessions, agent builder, session insights, CRM export, MCP) and Enterprise (adds on-premise deployment, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR, enterprise SLAs and a dedicated success team). Pricing depends on agents, demo volume, languages and integrations. Most teams start with a pilot.
- **Floe** says pricing depends on your demo volume, with no setup fee, and you talk to them for a quote ([cost page](https://floe.so/ai-demo-agent-questions/cost) , checked November 2026).


Note for readers of Floe's buyer's guide: it says Karumi's pricing page was removed. As of November 2026,[karumi.ai/pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) is live with both plans.


## Who is each one best for?


**Choose Floe if:**


- Your main goal is a website agent that answers questions from your docs on pricing, landing and comparison pages, then opens the product.
- You want the vendor's team to set it up with you in about 48 hours.
- You use Teams channels, Factors or Periskope.
- You do not need a finished SOC 2 Type II report yet.


**Choose Karumi if:**


- You want one agent across the website, outbound emails, Slack and live Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls.
- Your product ships often and the demo must stay in sync on its own.
- Security review is a gate: you need SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 now, or on-premise.
- You want qualification data and custom fields in HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio.


For a wider view of the category, see[what an AI demo agent is](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-is-an-ai-demo-agent) or our[Karumi vs Navattic](https://karumi.ai/blog/karumi-vs-navattic) comparison.


## FAQ


### Is Floe a Karumi alternative?


Yes. Both are AI demo agents that run your real product live by voice. Floe leans on its website agent; Karumi on one agent across every surface, including live calls.


### Do Karumi and Floe both use the real product?


Yes. Floe's docs say "the agent controls a real browser running your actual product." Karumi runs your real product live, not a recording, a replica or a tour. Both need a demo account with data you are happy for any prospect to see.


### Can Karumi or Floe join a Zoom or Google Meet call?


Karumi joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls. Floe's demo agent runs a video call on its own demo page; the Floe pages we read in November 2026 do not say it joins Meet, Zoom or Teams calls.


### Is Floe SOC 2 certified?


Not yet. As of November 2026, Floe's security page lists SOC 2 Type II as in progress and ISO 27001 as planned. Karumi is SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant.


### How long does setup take?


Floe says a code snippet and a demo account, then about 48 hours with its team. Karumi says hours, not weeks: you can generate a first-pass demo agent for free with no commitment, then refine it before anyone sees it.


### How much does Floe cost compared with Karumi?


Neither publishes a list price as of November 2026. Floe prices by demo volume with no setup fee. Karumi scopes its Growth and Enterprise plans on a call, often starting with a pilot.


## See it for yourself


The fastest way to compare is to watch both agents work. Karumi shows itself the way it would show your product: try a live demo at[karumi.ai/demos](https://karumi.ai/demos) .
